turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I didn't say it was open. Who decided on the zero?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
I still might. What do you have?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No. Show me what you're holding against my son, Hale, or take the zero off.
